cells.gaps: The 2024 NSO and MACRA study puts the share at 1.4 per cent; no measured share of half or more.
cells.note: A 2024 study by the National Statistical Office and MACRA measured 1.4 per cent of Malawians with digital skills, and the Digital Malawi Project had trained over 19,000 people. The share is far below half, so not stage 5.
